dedupe_keys.name: skogsstyrelsen geodata services swedish forest agency forest data for gis

description: The Swedish Forest Agency provides its geodata for use in users' own GIS through download services and direct connection services, so that current data is always available. Data can be downloaded through clickable links, with raster data by county or map square, from the agency's FTP server for the Skogliga grunddata (basic forest data), or through a REST API, and users can connect directly to the agency's geodatabases through WMS view services and REST services for machine to machine analysis. The Nemus web API lets companies submit forestry cases to the agency and county administrative boards. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the page is in Swedish, and the raster downloads need an account. Coverage is Sweden. It supports green infrastructure and forest condition analysis, for example storm and fire exposure of forests along power lines, roads and railways, and climate adaptation; related records are the German Bundeswaldinventur, the French DataIFN and the National Forest Inventory of Great Britain.
